text:
Marta (CS): Quick heads-up — had a 30m call with NovaHealth onboarding. They surfaced 6 feature asks and 3 blockers. Copying the highlights here so we can triage. TL;DR: cheaper embedding tier, per-route usage export, clearer onboarding docs and runbook.

Lina (CS): Can you drop the raw notes/snippets from the call?

Marta (CS): Sure — pasted from my notes:
```
- Customer: NovaHealth (pilot)
- Immediate asks: cheaper embedding pricing tier, per-route CSV/JSON usage export, dashboard for team-level quotas
- Pain points: onboarding docs too sparse for SSO+VPC setup, unclear retry guidance for rate-limited clients, missing examples for per-route billing toggles
- Business impact: pilot wants to expand from 5 -> 50 seats if cost bucketing exists
```

Jin (PM): Skimming — embedding pricing looks high-impact for expansion and renewal. Do we have per-customer token/embedding usage for Nova?

Analytics Bot: Report generated — https://redwood.internal/analytics/novah-usage (last 30d). Summary: embeddings = 42% of token cost for this account, spike on onboarding week.

Owen (Eng): Technical context: a cheaper embedding tier could be a quantized model variant (8-bit) with lower GPU cost on Dedicated/Dedicated-burst. Engineering caveats: need validation for embedding drift and similarity quality, perf testing on batch sizes. Rough ETA: 2 sprints to prototype + 1 sprint for validation.

Jin (PM): Proposal for quick prioritization: 1) cheaper embedding tier (revenue expansion), 2) per-route usage export (ops unblock), 3) onboarding runbook + SSO/VPC examples (reduce support load). Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Lina (CS): +1 on ranking. I can scope the onboarding doc work and collect exact SSO configs they used. Happy to own doc PR. :raised_hands:

Marta (CS): I'll confirm which teams in Nova will expand and grab any missing examples (screenshots, API call logs). Also will ask for any sample CSV they expect for per-route export.

Jin (PM): Can we create placeholder tickets with the `cs:customer-ask` tag and short impact notes? Use this quick template: `Title | Customer | Impact | Ask | Owner` — ping me on each.

Marta (CS): Will do. Creating issues now: `GH-4589 cheaper-embeddings-novah`, `GH-4590 per-route-export-novah`, `GH-4591 novah-onboarding-runbook`. I'll add notes and links.

Owen (Eng): Once GH-4589 exists, ping eng-runtime and eng-ml. We'll slot a spike in current sprint if PM prioritizes. Also: add `quant-eval` checklist to the issue.

Lina (CS): For onboarding docs, I'll draft a short runbook (README + screenshots) and propose a short walkthrough video (5-7 min).

Marta (CS): Follow-ups: I'll ask Nova for expected cost targets for embeddings (target $/10k embeddings) and a sample export shape. Back by EOD tomorrow with details.

Jin (PM): Perfect. If anyone objects to the prioritization, speak now; otherwise I'll include embedding tier in next sprint planning for discussion. :thumbsup:

Lina (CS): No objections from CS. +1.

Marta (CS): Thanks — filing the follow-ups and tagging people in GH issues.

Analytics Bot: Note: added `usage_snapshot_2026-03-23.csv` to GH-4590 when Marta creates it.

Jin (PM): Thanks team — I'll convert GH-4589 into an RFC if the spike proves promising.

Marta (CS): Closing loop here — will paste GH links once created and update this thread.
